name: listmonk

evidence.newsletter: F02: one-way mailing lists, bulk campaigns and scheduled newsletter sends
evidence.transactional: F02: POST /api/tx sends a reusable template for order, welcome and password-reset mail

line: Self-hosted mailing lists, bulk campaigns and transactional email API.

free.text: Free self-hosted software; supply a server, database and sender

cells.newsletters: Yes, bulk campaigns to mailing lists

subs.math: 1,000 contacts × 4 campaigns = 4,000 emails a month. $12 server (2GB) plus Amazon SES at $0.16 per 1,000, one recipient per email, with production access. Partial total: data, backups and tax are extra.
